detail.longDescription: Morning check, day twenty seven. Optiplex green, 7050 holding, Portainer, Vaultwarden and Gitea up. The 7B GGUF held the night at four tokens a second with the confidence of something triple its size before I stopped it. The utility letter is out, so the 3am mystery is a waiting game. The UPS went quiet tonight, so either the grid calmed down or it finally got bored. Tape and hope. # homelab # selfhosted
